review_limits: A100 fixed regression simulator uses 8x64-bit DMA, whereas A70 legacy sim16 uses 1x256-bit. Cross-profile simulation cycle ratios are not isolated frequency/pipeline speedups. Board A100 is 1x256-bit.
Existing ResetWrangler CDC-8 first-stage ASYNC_REG property is empty. Three-stage release structure is identified but full dynamic reset/MTBF closure was not performed.
Vendor PCIe CDC7/10/11 and CPLL capture structures were inspected on fresh DCPs and compared, without claiming all asynchronous reset sequences and multi-lane behavior are independently proven.
Unused HBM AXI1..15 clocks are GROUND; BREADY/RREADY are SIGNAL feedback from same-macro VALID_PIPE, not GND data ties.
No bitstream export, programming, board cold-start or attention test was performed.
